perks.name: Kill Clip

perks.name: Precision Instrument

perks.name: Alacrity

perks.name: Fleet Footed

perks.name: Roar of Battle

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 152 from 2 September 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/5y3KdXwOHAdEiERuX1NtGR?si=87414268eb9642d6) with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE utility roll for sustained damage in Boss fights in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, to boost fireteam DPS. This is the third version of Aisha's Embrace, with the frame intrinsic offering a ×0.8 animation scalar when reloading from an empty mag. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good, which is improved further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and mag perks are enhanced - d2foundry.gg calculates that 34 Range equates to 35.58m hipfire and 71.16m ADS before damage dropoff, 46 Stability is ×1.0650 flinch resist, 26 Handling is 0.47s ready, 0.37s ADS and 0.45s stow speed, 35 Reload Speed is 2.27s reload (1.82s with the frame intrinsic when empty) and Magazine Size is 17 (max 20). With the fire rate, Controllers might need some help with taming the recoil, but otherwise the two weapon stats that need the most help from the barrel and mag perks are Handling and Reload Speed. As a utility roll, for boss fights, you could try Shoot to Loot, to pick up remote ammo bricks or orbs during sustained boss fights and reloading all your weapons from reserves, together with Withering Gaze. On its own this will Weaken targets for ×1.15 damage for 6s for your fireteam after ADS-ing for 1.4s (1.3s when enhanced), refreshable on subsequent procs, but if the stronger ×1.3 weaken has been applied from Tractor Cannon or Shadowshot, Withering Gaze will reapply at the higher value. If you're interested, Aisha was a human Hunter and a close friend of Shayura, who, along with Reed-7, comprised a fireteam that faced a mysterious entity in Old Chicago, according to the Wild Hunt Vest armour description. The Fleet Footed Origin Trait's additional Airborne Effectiveness and Movement Speed are more of a PvP perk. Roar of Battle's +10 Handling and Stability is better, but unspectacular. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Directly competing with Contingency Plan and having similar competition with Servant Leader is tough. Aisha’s Embrace separates itself by both offering different zoom levels, as well as a very compelling perk pool. Having triple tap and vorpal on a full auto scout just feels right. You could also try to use shoot to loot or focused fury depending on how you want to spec your scout. Aisha’s Embrace offers some really good PvE utility that Contingency Plan just doesn’t have room to compete with.". Recommended MW - Range.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB): "Where Aisha’s Embrace does fall off is in the crucible. Which is weird considering it is a Trials of Osiris weapon. I think Contingency Plan wins out with access to kill clip, firmly planted and a lower zoom by comparison. You can try and make Aisha’s Embrace work with perpetual motion and multikill clip, but it won’t be as easy to use.". Recommended MW - Handling.
